notablePrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness. You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
